a.lede: Tencent is reportedly renting 100,000 AI chips from Oracle data centers in Southeast Asia for about $7 billion over five years.
a.title: Tencent scores 100,000 offshore AI chip deal with Oracle for $7 billion despite climbing prices

b.lede: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
b.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
